title: Monkey waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M28 72 Q10 70 12 52 Q14 40 24 42 Q30 43 29 50" fill="none" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left arm with paw waving -->
  <path d="M34 58 Q24 50 20 36 Q18 28 24 25" fill="none" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="23" r="7" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="18" r="2.2" fill="#f4c690"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="17" r="2.2" fill="#f4c690"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="21" r="2.2" fill="#f4c690"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="66" rx="19" ry="22" fill="#b5712e"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="68" rx="11" ry="15" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="40" y="82" width="8" height="12" rx="4" fill="#b5712e"/>
  <rect x="56" y="82" width="8" height="12" rx="4" fill="#b5712e"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#7a4a1e"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#7a4a1e"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d="M70 58 Q80 62 82 72" fill="none" stroke="#c68642" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="74" r="6" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="36" r="8" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="36" r="4" fill="#f2b98a"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="36" r="8" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="36" r="4" fill="#f2b98a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="20" fill="#b5712e"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#e0a86a"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="36" r="3.2" fill="#5a3410"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="36" r="3.2" fill="#5a3410"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="35" r="1.1" fill="#fff3dc"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="35" r="1.1" fill="#fff3dc"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 47 Q50 52 56 47" fill="none" stroke="#5a3410" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#7a4a1e"/>
</svg>
